主题：Escrow Release Procedures
Escrow release conditions:

1. Release funds only when ALL conditions in the Conditions column are marked 'Met'
2. If any condition is 'Pending' or 'Not Met': hold the escrow
3. Escrow items disputed by either party (check Dispute column): route to legal@company.example.com
4. Notify the beneficiary and the depositor when funds are released
5. Update status to 'Released' or 'Held' accordingly

- Legal"}
